articles.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
articles.summary: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

articles.title: Apple’s touchscreen MacBook Pro pushes laptop pricing to a new extreme
articles.summary: Prepare to cough up around $14,549 if you want the new touchscreen MacBook Pro to have every upgrade.

articles.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
articles.summary: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

articles.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
articles.summary: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

articles.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
articles.summary: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

articles.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
articles.summary: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

articles.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
articles.summary: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
articles.summary: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

articles.title: Xreal Aura is a new wired headset powered by Android XR
articles.summary: Xreal Aura will start at $1,279 and will have multiple XR specific apps at launch.

articles.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
articles.summary: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.

articles.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
articles.summary: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.

articles.title: Reddit is the latest platform to embrace the ‘For You’ feed
articles.summary: The For You feed combines posts from communities users have joined with recommendations tailored to their interests.

articles.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
articles.summary: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.

articles.title: Trump DOE loans $5B to nuclear plants that will power data centers
articles.summary: Constellation Energy will get $5 billion in government loans to modernize nuclear reactors. Most of the new capacity is already committed to Google, Amazon, and Meta.

articles.title: South Korea’s financial industry hit by fresh wave of cyberattacks
articles.summary: South Korea’s financial institutions have been hit by another wave of cyberattacks, highlighting the growing risk of AI-driven hacking in Asia.

articles.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
articles.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

articles.title: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices
